## Primary architectural advance

CodexStation Ω no longer treats cross-project aggregation as document accumulation.

It treats each governed project as a **source world** that is mounted, revision-mapped, harvested, quantized and linked into a provider-independent global kernel/knowledge lattice.

```text
SOURCE WORLD
-> MOUNT
-> REVISION MAP
-> DEEP MAP
-> ProjectHarvestCapsule
-> KnowledgeQuantum
-> LatticeAdmission
-> GLOBAL LATTICE
-> Holotope
-> Archetonic Plate
-> Kernel / Skill Composition
-> VERIFY / WITNESS
-> FeedbackPacket
-> SOURCE WORLD
```

## Use

When a canonical project URL is supplied:

```text
MOUNT::SOURCE_ROOT=<canonical project root>
MODE::DEEP_MAP+DELTA_HARVEST
NEXT()
```

Resolve the project START/HANDOFF/AGENTS and local authority before loading Ω aggregation context.

Use:
- `codexstation-omega-project-mount` for mount and delta workflow;
- `codexstation-omega-harvester` for project objectization and crystallization;
- the public orchestrator for ROOT/NEXT/REGRESSION/PACK routing.
